champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.tldr: Innate: After casting an ability, Bel'Veth gains 2 stacks for 5 seconds, stacking up to 6 times and refreshing on subsequent ability casts. While Bel'Veth has stacks, she becomes ghosted and gains 25–50% bonus attack …
champions.gameplayImpact: Bel'Veth was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: After casting an ability, Bel'Veth gains 2 stacks for 5 seconds, stacking up to 6 times and refreshing on subsequent ability casts. While Bel'Veth has stacks, she becomes ghosted and gains 25–50% bonus attack speed. Her basic attacks each consume 1 stack.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Whenever Bel'Veth scores a takedown against a champion or monster within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains stacks of Lavender permanently. Large monsters grant her 1 stack and champions and epic monsters grant her 2. Each stack grants her 0.25–1.25% bonus attack speed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bel'Veth can exceed the attack speed cap, but all sources of damage dealt or triggered by her basic attacks are reduced by 25%, including on-hit effects. She cannot gain attack speed through growth (per level).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth dash a fixed distance in a designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing 10–30 (+ 110% AD) physical damage to enemies she passes through and applying on-hit and spell effects at 75% effectiveness to the first target hit.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Surge can critically strike for .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Surge deals 120% damage to monsters and 60–100% damage against minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Surge can only be cast in each of Bel'Veth's cardinal directions with a cooldown that incurs between casts. Each direction has a unique cooldown that is reduced equivalent to 0.25 ability haste per .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: These cooldowns reset upon respawning.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Surge basic attack reset Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Per-Direction Cooldown: seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Range: 400, Collision Radius: er , Cast Time: None.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Speed: .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth slams her tail down in the target direction, dealing 70–230 (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 125% AP) magic damage to enemies struck, airborne for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 50% for 1.25–2.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hitting an enemy champion with Above and Below resets dash cooldown of the direction they were hit.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 12–8 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Range: cr 0 - er 660, Width: er 200, Cast Time: 0.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest current health percentage 6 (+ 1 per ) times over 1.5 seconds, dealing 8–20 (+ 6% AD) physical damage with each slash, increased by 0–300% (over 0–100)|health, and applying on-hit, on-attack, and spell effects at 6–24% (over 0–100)|health effectiveness.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Royal Maelstrom deals 150% damage to monsters and its attacks applies lifesteal life steal but cannot critically strike.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bel'Veth gains 70% damage reduction, 20–28% (+ ) life steal, and is unable to move during Royal Maelstrom. She cannot perform slashes while unable to declare basic attacks.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Royal Maelstrom can be recast after 0.75 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when Bel'Veth casts an ability.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Bel'Veth ends Royal Maelstrom.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Effect Radius: er 500, Cast Time: None.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive: Bel'Veth's basic attacks on-hit apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and expiring upon attacking a new target. Every second attack on-hit against the marked target deals 6–10 (3 ranks) (+ 12% bonus AD) bonus true damage and grants a stack that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 5 stacks against epic monster.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Additionally, whenever Bel'Veth scores a takedown against a champion or epic monster while being alive, a Void Coral is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. and summon an enhanced Void Coral.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth dash to the target Void Coral and consumes it over the cast time, slow nearby enemies by 25%, which ramps up to 99% over the duration, then creates an explosion that deals 150–250 (3 ranks) (+ 100% AP) (+ 25–35 (3 ranks)% of target's missing health) true damage to them. Upon consumption, Bel'Veth also consumes all other existing Void Corals, gains a stack of Death in Lavender|Lavender}} per Void Coral consumed, and assumes her True Form for 60 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If Bel'Veth consumed at least one enhanced Void Coral, she gains an enhanced True Form that lasts 180 seconds and causes Void Remora to spawn from the deaths of nearby lane minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Remora have 70% of the minion's maximum health and 110% of the minion's AD.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: True Form: Bel'Veth evolves into a monster, gaining 100–200 (3 ranks) (+ 165% bonus AD) (+ 90% AP) bonus health, 25–75 (3 ranks) bonus movement speed out-of-combat, 50–100 (3 ranks) bonus attack range, as well as 10–20 (3 ranks)% increased total attack speed. She also gains the ability to dash through terrain with Void Surge}}. Consuming Void Corals while in this state refreshes the duration of True Form and heal Bel'Veth for 100–200 (3 ranks) (+ 165% bonus AD) (+ 90% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Effect Radius: cr 500, Cast Time: 1 second.
